FIELDS.NAME: ClearWave Communications
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, ClearWave Communications, 555-123-4567, john.smith@clearwave.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ClearWave Communications specializes in providing comprehensive cable and telecommunications services, including high-speed internet, digital television, and voice services to residential and small to medium-sized commercial clients. Our operations are streamlined for efficiency, allowing us to deliver quality installations, repairs, and support with a focus on customer satisfaction. We maintain a robust safety program and engage certified technicians who comply with industry standards, ensuring reliable service delivery while minimizing on-site risks. We pride ourselves on a strong history of effective risk management, evidenced by our record of minimal claims and a commitment to adhering to safety protocols and operational standards. Additionally, we have clear contracts in place for all our services, which helps clarify liability and responsibilities. Our strategic focus on customer service, safety, and compliance positions us well for growth in the telecommunications market.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: ClearWave Technologies, LLC - A subsidiary focused on cybersecurity solutions for telecommunications infrastructures.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates from 01/10/2023 to 02/15/2023 due to equipment theft valued at $3,000. The case is currently resolved, with the police investigation completed. Additionally, an incident on 01/20/2023 involving minor water damage from a burst pipe incurred $2,000 and is also resolved with repairs completed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class I, Grade A, UL Listed Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: "Provision of perimeter fencing, illuminated security cameras, and on-site security personnel during business hours to enhance surveillance and protect property from unauthorized access."
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – ClearWave Communications does not engage in operations involving the storage, treatment, discharge, application, disposal, or transportation of hazardous materials. The company focuses on providing telecommunications services, which do not involve such activities.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – ClearWave Communications does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its business operations. The company primarily focuses on providing telecommunications services to residential and commercial clients.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our designated compliance officer to ensure they meet the required standards.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – ClearWave Communications has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or arson-related crimes in connection with this or any other property. We maintain a strong commitment to ethical practices and compliance.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – ClearWave Communications has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. We maintain a consistent and compliant insurance record.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – ClearWave Communications does not lease employees to or from other employers, focusing on in-house staffing to maintain consistency and control over service quality.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – ClearWave Communications carries Workers Compensation coverage, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and protection for its employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – ClearWave Communications owns a subsidiary, ClearWave Technologies, LLC, which focuses on providing cybersecurity solutions for telecommunications infrastructures.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – ClearWave Communications does not currently hold any other insurance policies with this company. All necessary coverage is provided under the existing policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – ClearWave Communications is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our primary focus is on providing telecommunications services, including installation and repair for residential and commercial clients.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: Yes – ClearWave Communications does rent equipment to clients for telecommunications services, ensuring all rentals are covered by contracts and comply with insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – ClearWave Communications has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The company maintains a stable financial position and a strong history of effective risk management.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – ClearWave Communications does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on telecommunications services without involving hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – ClearWave Communications does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are primarily focused on providing telecommunications services and are not located in high-risk areas for disasters. Additionally, we maintain robust safety protocols and compliance measures to mitigate any potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – ClearWave Communications has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring, demonstrating a commitment to ethical practices and compliance in all operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – ClearWave Communications does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and maintaining a secure operational environment.
